ios.desc:
Manage multiple loops of multiple timers that can repeat on a customizable schedule. With Timer Loops, you can create as many timers as you need and customize their duration, label, and repeat frequency. 

Our app is perfect for anyone who needs to stay on track with their daily routines, whether it's for work, exercise, cooking, or any other activity. You can even use it as a reminder to take breaks or practice mindfulness throughout the day.

Some features of our app include:

- Timer loops: repeat not only timers but whole sets of timers!
- Customizable timer duration and repeat frequency
- Multiple timer group management: save different groups of timers for different activities
